messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: PD service-binding -> staging-rollout-group. Alert: p99 response latency spike + 5xx increase. link: https://telemetry.redwood/alerts/7141592653
incident-bot: details: route=/api/v1/generate, recent 5xx rate 7.8% (baseline 0.3%), p99 2400ms (baseline 220ms)
ria: saw the PD page come in, routing dashboard looks like a single release shard is hot. tagging @miguel @sam
pd-bot: PagerDuty incident #INC7141592653 created. Escalation policy: staging-deploys -> eng-oncall -> eng-ops.
miguel: acked via pd-bot. I'm pulling logs for the batch workers and the model-serving pods.
sam: acked. Initial guess: rollout v2026.04 has a kernel change for quant path; could be introducing small perf cliffs under certain seq lengths.
jen: FYI customer-impact: few staging clients on the feature flag, not prod. No customer-visible errors yet but staging tests failing.
miguel: logs show repeated "kvcache miss" + OOMish GC cycles on one node: kube-node-42. stack snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:17:12Z ERROR serve: request failed: alloc failed: cannot reserve 1.2GiB
runtime: panic: allocation failure
```
ria: on the metrics side, the node shows memory climb correlated with sequence lengths > 2048 in the test set. p95 latency for that node is 1.7s, others are normal.
sam: rolling traffic split shows 12% to v2026.04 across region-us-west-2; we can shift to 1% or pause. Can someone drop the staged-rollout flag?
jen: recommend traffic diversion + scale fix. Ops-lead, want a rollback or traffic pause?
ops-lead: if it's isolated to a shard and not config-wide, pause rollout first. rollback if pause doesn't quiesce in 5-10m.
miguel: I'm SSHing into kube-node-42 to check kernel messages and node-level oom. If it's a bad quant kernel, we might need a hotfix to force legacy path.
ria: I'm updating the incident board: https://incidents.redwood/board/7141592653. tagging runbook: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/deploy-regression.md
sam: applying traffic diversion: `POST /api/rollouts/controls` payload -> set percentage 1 for v2026.04 in us-west-2. running curl now:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN" \
  "https://control-plane/rollouts/us-west-2" \
  -d '{"model_version":"v2026.04","percent":1}'
```
sam: done. traffic to v2026.04 dropped to 1%. monitoring...
jen: pinging QA to run targeted seq>2048 test cases against v2026.03 to confirm baseline.
pd-bot: Note: incident escalations will trigger if incident not acknowledged by eng-ops within 8 minutes.
miguel: found kernel log: `segfault in quant-kernel.c:457` repeated. Patch candidate: set env VAR `USE_LEGACY_KERNEL=true` for affected deployment.
ria: do we have an automated canary rollback button in console? I can trigger a rollback if ops-lead gives thumbs. :thumbsup:
ops-lead: thumbs for pause + env flip first. rollback only if errors persist.
sam: rolling an env update to the shard with `USE_LEGACY_KERNEL=true` via k8s patch now. command: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/model-serv-v2026-04 USE_LEGACY_KERNEL=true --record`
jen: QA reports first round looks green on v2026.03, and the small cohort on v2026.04 is now showing p99 down to ~260ms after env flip.
miguel: node-level memory usage dropping post-env-change, GC cycles normalizing. no new OOMs for 4m.
ria: good sign. leaving incident open for 30m observation window. will we roll forward with a rollback/patch PR?
ops-lead: create PR to remove the quant-kernel change until we have regression test coverage. assign to @miguel. Also schedule postmortem.
mgmt-note: timeline and customer-impact: staging-only, no external SLA hits. still treat as severity-2 due to regression risk.
miguel: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/serve/pulls/789 - title: revert quant kernel change (temp).
sam: marking runbook step "pause-rollout" as completed.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: incident marked as acknowledged by eng-ops. Next escalation timers suspended.
ria: handing off to on-call for monitoring window. @eng-oncall please watch for 30m and post any reoccurrence.
jen: I'll coordinate postmortem and test additions for seq>2048 in CI.
ops-lead: thanks team. closing actions: scale observation, PR to revert, add regression tests, update runbook with env flip option.
ria: closing thread to move to postmortem channel once incident is stale. :white_check_mark:
